paragraphs.text: I am safe as God is safe in the heavens and no one can hurt me.

paragraphs.text: Thus he speaks by derision: for Daniel had declared notable signs of his wisdom in Babylon, when Ezekiel wrote this.

paragraphs.text: Like the rest of the heathen and infidels who are God's enemies.

paragraphs.text: He derides the vain opinion and confidence that the Tyrians had in their riches, strength and pleasures.
paragraphs.label: d

paragraphs.text: He means the royal state of Tyre, which for the excellency and glory of it he compares to the cherubim which covered the Ark, and by "anointed" he signifies the same.

paragraphs.text: I did you this honour to make you one of the builders of my temple, which was when Hiram sent to Solomon things necessary for the work.

paragraphs.text: That is, among my people Israel, which shined as precious stones.

paragraphs.text: Which was when I first called you to this dignity.
